cases.name: empty
cases.fairness: Temporal liveness obligations explicitly imply the original per-action Fairness predicate. Step includes stuttering; nextStep preserves the original enabled relation.

assumptions: Checked formula in FactWriteDedupe_empty: WriteReturns = Fairness implies Writers.forall(w => eventually(s.pc.get(w) == "done"))
Model fairness predicate Fairness = Writers.forall(w => WriterStep(w).weakFair(s))
The stated fairness is an assumption about enabled model actions; runtime scheduling and provider completion are not proved.

No scheduler fairness is assumed by this property.
